title: State Variables and Data Structures
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in State Variables and Data Structures and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 7: State Variables and Data Structures; it lists all 15 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 7 roadmap: State Variables and Persistent Contract Data; Local Variables and Temporary Data; State Variable Visibility and Generated Getters; Constants and Immutable Variables; Arrays in Solidity; Fixed-Size Arrays; Dynamic Arrays and Resizing; Iterating Over Arrays; Adding and Removing Array Elements; Mapping Types and Key-Value Storage; Nested Mappings; Structs Combined with Arrays and Mappings; Enums in State Machines; Common Data Modeling Patterns; Efficient Collection Design and Storage Costs. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
